work: A Mad Tea-Party, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
alt: The March Hare and the Hatter sit at a tea table crowded with cups and a teapot, the Dormouse asleep between them.

work: The Tower of Babel (Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna)
alt: A huge unfinished tower rises in pale stone tiers around a rock outcrop, its upper levels raw red brick still under construction.
Three hooded old women in profile, faces in a row under pale drapery, pointing together with overlapping outstretched arms.

work: And So Was His Grandfather, Los Caprichos plate 39 (The Met)
alt: A seated donkey studies an open book whose pages show rows of donkeys.
Munch's figure presses both hands to its head, eyes wide and mouth open in an oval.
A jester in a yellow hood with ass's ears laughs, one hand spread over his face, the other holding a pair of spectacles.
A conjurer in a tall black hat and red robe holds a small ball up between two fingers, an owl peering out of the basket at his belt.
A small rowing boat with a standing white-draped figure approaches a rocky island whose center is closed off by tall dark cypresses.
An elderly woman in a horned headdress about twice as wide as her head, an old-fashioned low-cut bodice, one hand raised before her chest.

work: Tweedledum and Tweedledee, Through the Looking-Glass
alt: One stout twin stamps and clutches his head while the other's feet stick out from under an open umbrella, with Alice standing beside them.

work: The Infante Baltasar Carlos on Horseback
alt: A small boy prince in a black hat and red sash holds up a baton and sits calmly on a dark horse rearing on its hind legs.

work: Arrangement in Grey and Black No. 1
alt: A woman in a long black dress and white cap sits upright in profile, hands folded in her lap over a white handkerchief.
A bearded scholar writes at a desk, head bent, while a lion and a small dog lie asleep on the floor in front of him.

work: The Lawyers, Les Gens de Justice
alt: A robed advocate leans far over the bar mid-speech, mouth open, while a smaller robed figure in a cap sits behind him.

work: You are old, Father William, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
alt: Old Father William stands on his head, feet in the air, while a young man holding a stick looks on with one palm open.

work: Death's Door, from Blair's The Grave
alt: An old man bent over a crutch walks into a dark stone doorway, while on the rock above it a young figure sits up and looks skyward.
Mars sits slumped in his helmet with his chin on his hand, a blue cloth across his lap, a staff held loosely in his other hand.
A moneylender weighs coins on a small balance while his wife, turning a page of an illuminated prayer book, looks across at the coins.

work: The Eye, Like a Strange Balloon, Mounts Toward Infinity
alt: A huge eye rises like a hot-air balloon, its iris turned upward, with a small dark object hanging beneath it.
An owl strums a guitar and a cat sits beside a jar labelled HONEY, the two of them together in a small boat.
A pale blue elephant carries a tall red-and-white tower on its back, five heads in helmets, hoods and caps crowded along the top.

work: The Garden of Earthly Delights, outer wings
alt: The two closed outer wings show, in grey-green, a transparent sphere holding a flat disc of land under clouds, split by the seam between the panels.
A spider whose round, furry body is a sad human face with a tear on its cheek stands on long thin legs.
A man in a fur-trimmed robe and wide black hat raises his right hand, holding the hand of a woman in a green dress; a small dog at their feet.

work: The Bremen Town Musicians, from 50 småhistorier
alt: A donkey rears up carrying a dog, a cat and a crowing rooster stacked one on top of another.
Two grinning hobgoblins in hooded monks' habits stand together, each holding a cup, the taller one raising his free hand.
A single spider drawn from above, striped legs spread, its large abdomen covered in a pale, intricate pattern.
A young man leans over a stone ledge blowing through a thin straw while a small child in a cap watches.

work: The Garden of Earthly Delights, left panel (detail)
alt: A pale hybrid creature with a cracked, speckled pot-like body, frog-like legs and a dark pointed head emerging from an opening at one end.

work: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
alt: A man seen from behind in a dark coat, a walking stick in his hand.
A man in a wide black hat and lace ruff smiles faintly under an upturned moustache, one hand on his hip, his sleeve densely embroidered.
Six men in black, five in tall hats and one bareheaded behind them, look up from a table with an open book; one is half-risen from his chair.
Puss in Boots, in a plumed hat, cape, belt and boots, throws both paws up with his mouth wide open, crying out.
A woman in a frothy pink dress and hat swings high, one leg kicked out, gripping the ropes.
A young woman in a blue and yellow turban looks back over her shoulder at the viewer, lips slightly parted, a large pearl at her ear.
A bearded man in a black beret and grey fur-trimmed coat, hands clasped, looks steadily at the viewer with blue eyes.
A man drawn in brown ink in two overlapping positions, arms level and raised, feet together and apart.
A woman in a white head covering and blue fur-trimmed jacket, eyes lowered, holding something small between thumb and finger.
Two workers in torn, patched clothes: a young man carrying a basket of broken stone and an older man in a straw hat raising a hammer.

work: Aquamanile in the Form of a Lion
alt: A seated bronze lion with a curly mane, wide eyes and a toothy grin, a round filling hole on top of its head and a handle curving along its back.
Three passengers on a bench: a young woman nursing a baby, an older woman in a hood with her hands on a basket, and a boy slumped asleep beside her.

work: Monstrous Craws, At a New Coalition Feast
alt: Three diners seated around one bowl heaped with gold coins, each lifting a spoon of coins to the mouth, each with a huge pouch hanging from the throat.

work: The Turk, chess automaton, from Racknitz's book on Kempelen's machine
alt: Cutaway of the chess automaton: a robed, turbaned figure above a cabinet, with a man hidden inside at a small chessboard.
A monkey in a long ochre robe seated on a red stool, holding a magnifying glass up to a small object in its other hand, with books and loose papers stacked beside it.
Two dark monkeys chained to the same iron ring, one sitting up and facing out, the other curled over with its head bowed.
The painter at his canvas, the young princess in a pale gown with her maids of honor, two court dwarfs and a large dog lying in front.
A half-length figure built mostly of books (an open book fanned out as hair, stacked volumes forming the chest and arms) with a bristling grey beard.
A rhinoceros in profile drawn as if in riveted armor plates, with scaled legs, a nose horn and a small twisted horn on its shoulder.
A young man in a black cap and dark coat with red satin sleeves holding an opened letter, a glass vase of carnations at his side.

work: Self-Portrait with Death Playing the Fiddle
alt: The bearded painter in a dark jacket, brush in one hand and palette in the other, with a grinning skull and bony fingers just behind his ear.
Thisbe in a red patterned robe and sash, barefoot, leaning forward with one hand raised to her ear.

work: The Lion and the Unicorn, Through the Looking-Glass
alt: Alice stands holding a large dish of cake between the Unicorn on the left and the Lion on the right, with a hare-eared figure behind.

work: Painting the roses, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
alt: Three playing-card gardeners marked with spades, holding brushes, one with a paint pot, two leaning face to face beside a rose tree; a second pot lies at their feet.
A lion stands over a sleeping figure in a striped robe, with a mandolin and a water jug beside her.

work: The Fight Between Carnival and Lent
alt: A stout man in a green cap rides a barrel mounted on a sled, holding a roasting spit like a lance, a pot hanging below; a man in a fool's cap follows with a jug.

work: Kohada Koheiji, from One Hundred Ghost Stories
alt: A skeletal ghost with thin hair grips the red edge of a mosquito net with bony fingers and peers over it.

work: Ni más ni menos, Los Caprichos plate 41
alt: A donkey sits upright with its forelegs resting in front of it, head lifted, posing, while a dark monkey figure works at an easel behind it.
A line of blind men linked by staffs and hands on shoulders, several with faces turned upward, while the man at the front stumbles and falls forward.

work: The Sleep of Reason Produces Monsters, Los Caprichos plate 43
alt: A man slumped forward with his head buried in his arms; behind him an owl and a large cat.

work: Saint George and the Dragon (Paris version)
alt: A knight on a pale horse drives a lance into the open mouth of a green winged dragon.

work: The White Rabbit, The Nursery Alice
alt: The White Rabbit in a checked jacket and waistcoat, looking at a pocket watch, an umbrella tucked under his arm.

work: Skeleton kneeling in prayer, Osteographia, plate 36
alt: A full human skeleton kneeling on a low slab, hands pressed together, skull tipped upward.

work: The Queen of Hearts, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
alt: The Queen of Hearts points with her whole arm at Alice, with the King and card courtiers behind.

work: Basilisk, from Aldrovandi's Serpentum et draconum historiae
alt: A crowned basilisk with a rooster's beaked head, a scaly body on a row of short legs, and a long tail curling into a hook.
God the Father in a red cloak, borne by a crowd of figures, his arm stretched out to the left.
Two ambassadors standing full-length, far apart, with a shelf of instruments between them.
Two men in dark coats and caps seen from behind, one resting his hand on the other's shoulder.
A pale, spotted salamander lying stretched along a row of red flames, head raised and tail curled, beside a small green tree.
A head and chest built from produce: wheat ears and grapes in the hair, a pear nose, cherries at the mouth, a large gourd for a chest and flowers across the shoulders.
Liberty raising the tricolour high, a boy beside her with a pistol raised, and fallen bodies at her feet.
Leonidas seated at the centre with a round shield behind him, surrounded by nearly nude warriors reaching, turning and climbing.
A dark, heavily muscled figure with a small head strides forward in profile, holding a shallow bowl out in one hand.
Van Gogh head and shoulders in a fur cap and green coat, a white bandage across his cheek and ear, gaze turned slightly aside.

work: You Who Cannot, Los Caprichos plate 42
alt: Two men walking bent under two donkeys riding on their backs, their faces turned down.
A small, pointy-eared, grinning child sits on a mossy mound, one arm flung up and a bunch of flowers in the other hand.
Don Quixote and his horse hoisted up on a windmill sail, the horse hanging head-down and the armoured knight dangling beside it.

work: English Pouter, Monographie des pigeons domestiques
alt: An English Pouter pigeon standing tall on long feathered legs, its crop inflated into a ball larger than the rest of its body, tail angled down behind.

work: Napoleon I on his Imperial Throne
alt: Napoleon enthroned in a laurel wreath, ermine and red velvet, holding a rod of office in each hand.
